MSI Immerse Maestro 300 Detailed Specifications

  • Headphone Type: Over-Ear, Closed-Back Gaming Headset

  • Connection Interface: Wired via USB 2.0 (Includes Native USB Type-C Cable & USB Type-C to Type-A Adapter)

  • Driver Size: 40 mm High-Res Drivers (Neodymium Magnets)

  • Frequency Response (Headphones): 20 Hz – 40,000 Hz (Hi-Res Audio Certified)

  • Impedance: 32 Ω

  • Sensitivity (SPL): 109 dB ± 3 dB

  • Virtual Surround Sound: Spatial Audio / 7.1 Virtual Surround Sound (Supported via MSI Center Software)

Microphone Specifications

  • Microphone Type: Unidirectional, Detachable Cardioid Mic

  • Frequency Response (Microphone): 100 Hz – 10,000 Hz

  • Sensitivity (Microphone): -36 dB ± 3 dB

  • Impedance (Microphone): ≤ 2.2 KΩ

  • Microphone Mute: Physical toggle switch on the ear cup

Design & Comfort

  • Ear Cup Material: Breathable Mesh Fabric with High-Density Memory Foam Ear Pads

  • Headband: Lightweight, adjustable suspension headband design

  • Lighting Effect: Sleek, integrated ambient lighting on the earcups (Controlled via MSI Center)
